== Summary ==
Decipher set card art

== Provenance ==
This is a cropped copy of the [[Decipher]] web image for [[Death Star: Trench]]. Its 490 × 350 decoded pixels exactly match the rectangle starting at x=3, y=3 in [[:File:ANH-L-deathstartrench-decipher-archive.gif|the original Decipher web image]]; outer padding and drop shadow are omitted. The card artwork, frame, text, icons and copyright line are unchanged.<ref>[http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/deathstartrench.gif Death Star: Trench card image], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021214212316/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/deathstartrench.gif Internet Archive], 14 December 2002 (original bytes checked).</ref>

The [[Players Committee]] distributes the same cropped file in its Holotable image collection.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/deathstartrench.gif Holotable card image], Players Committee, member <code>Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/deathstartrench.gif</code> (identical bytes).</ref> An identical copy occurs at that member path in repository commit <code>022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153</code>.<ref>[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/deathstartrench.gif Historical Holotable card image], Players Committee, commit <code>022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153</code> (identical bytes). Complete [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Git commit object], author and committer dated 8 July 2018.</ref>
